archive_snapshot.note: Pinned to the research-branch 2026-11-07 snapshot for same-target comparability with Q88. Main has one newer draw through 2026-11-08; it is intentionally excluded from this frozen experiment.

formula_grammar: All unique unordered nine-feature equal-weight subsets of the 27 registered prior-only features; finite grammar, not all mathematical formulas.

null_model.assumption: Under the registered uniform-draw null, each target quintet is a uniform 5-of-40 sample independent of the past-only ranking.
null_model.per_target_hit_distribution: For a ranking top-k set, the number of actual quintet numbers in it is Hypergeometric(N=40,K=k,n=5), k in {5,10,20}.
null_model.p_value: Conservative Chernoff upper bound for the sum of per-target hypergeometric hit counts within each chronological split; use as a conservative p-value.
null_model.correction: One global Holm-Bonferroni family over every formula x split x endpoint (4,686,825 x 3 x 3 = 42,181,425 tests).

selection_protocol.discovery: Rank all formulas by mean Top-5 hit share descending; tie-break lower mean rank then lexicographic formula rank. Retain top 100.
selection_protocol.validation: Select one candidate from Discovery top-100 using Validation only; freeze before opening Blind OOS.
selection_protocol.blind_oos: Read Blind OOS only for the frozen candidate; never rank or select formulas using Blind OOS.
selection_protocol.target_ledger: Best formula per target is retrospective/descriptive only, not a forecast or candidate-selection input.

guardrails: Every target feature vector uses the complete archive prefix strictly before that target; state updates occur after feature construction.
Rank all 40 numbers before scoring the actual quintet.
Verify all 30 shard intervals are contiguous, non-overlapping and exhaustive.
Do not overwrite the immutable target-2026-10-25 prospective freeze or shadow_forecasts.csv.
Do not mark Q89 COMPLETE; acceptance, persistence, exact-head CI and human review/integration are separate gates.
No automatic model promotion, shadow insertion or merge.
Thresholded, nonlinear, interaction and ten-plus-feature grammars remain open future experiments.
